project_title: Children's Book Character Sheet Illustrator Needed

project_metadata.job_title: Children's Book Character Sheet Illustrator Needed
project_metadata.job_description:
I am looking for a talented children's book illustrator to create professional character sheets for my children's book.
Requirements:
Experience with children's book illustrations
Ability to create consistent, expressive character designs
Character turnaround (front, side, and back views)
Multiple facial expressions and poses
Clean, high-quality artwork
Good communication and attention to detail
Please include your portfolio, especially any children's book or character design work.
If your work is a good fit, there will be opportunities for more illustration projects in the future.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Have you previously created illustrations for children's books or designed character sheets? Please send over your portfolio.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, I've worked on children's book illustrations and produced professional character sheets with consistent designs. My attached portfolio contains samples of both character designs and illustrations for children's books. I'd be glad to discuss your project in more detail.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Are you able to make character turnarounds showing the front, side, and back, as well as multiple facial expressions and poses?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, definitely. I can produce front, side, and back views for the character turnaround, plus various poses and facial expressions, while maintaining a consistent character design throughout.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: What software do you work with when creating illustrations?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Depending on the project and its required art style, I primarily work with Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator,chat gpt.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Are you able to finish this project within the $5 budget?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, I can complete only the character sheet.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please send the character requirements so I can review them 1st.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Sir, please share any sample idea you may have.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Would you please provide me with your email address?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hello sir, I hope all is well with you.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I have completed your work; please review it. Thanks.
